method: Independent math.fsum weighted moments and cell sufficient-statistic standardization. No production script imports or execution.
methodology_notes: Common cell masses use min(weighted mass other,middle), then the same cell mass for both regimes.

Equal-entity matching includes entity in the cell and divides common per-entity cell masses by that entity common total. Each retained entity has mass one and both regimes keep identical cell composition.
Train stratified samples retain original positive inclusion weights before matching or subgroup equal-entity normalization. They are estimates, not fullTrain replay.

Mandatory identity is target_index/entity_id/seq/split. target_id is enforced when present in both; missing legacy target_id is not fabricated. Saved truth and history agreement uses rtol1e-7/atol1e-6; no causal or exact-binary claim.
No-support rows preserve N/A_no_common_support and blank metrics, not zeros. Sparse flags use under30 rows or under5 entities in either regime.
All input paths are pinned by the two prior input manifests, prior ROW_COVERAGE hash and additional qualification allowlist. Current input ledger hashes matched.
Truth-conditioned reweighting is retrospective, and only supported entities/cells remain. It cannot establish predictive routing or mechanism causality.
limitations: MLP16 and CurrentOnly Train missing; no full four-arm Train comparison.
MLP4/controls52/62 row predictions missing; 3seed mechanistic consistency cannot be evaluated.
Qualification first512 is nonrepresentative auxiliary coverage.
MLP16 Taxi/RAF42 CPU provenance differs from nativeMLP4.
No formal inference, significance, causal attribution or architecture efficacy established.
